attachments.origin_landmark: canine fossa of the maxilla, just below the infraorbital foramen
attachments.insertion_landmark: modiolus at the angle of the mouth, blending with zygomaticus major, depressor anguli oris and orbicularis oris (the schema takes a bone id; the true attachment is cartilage/skin and is named in the landmark text)

actions: raises the angle of the mouth and deepens the nasolabial furrow (smiling)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population

fiber_architecture.evidence: no measured architecture recorded: no PCSA, fascicle length or force verified from a source for this muscle (Q65 rule: numbers only where a source gives them)

functional_compartments.function_note: Lies deep to levator labii superioris and zygomaticus minor; the infraorbital nerve and vessels emerge above its origin -- the structure at risk in the canine fossa.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
